title.narrative: Accelerating and Strengthening malaria control in Mozambique - Mozambique (01-Jul-2015-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Mozambique, Malaria, Ministry of Health of Mozambique (MISAU)This program has the following goals: By 2016, halve the malaria morbidity and mortality rates observed in 2009. The objectives of this program are: By 2016, 100% of the population has access to at least one malaria prevention method. By 2016, develop the capacity to effectively manage malaria control at central, provincial and district level. By 2016, reach 100% of the population with information on malaria, with at least 60% following best practice malaria prevention and treatment behaviors. By 2016, strengthen surveillance, monitoring and evaluation systems so 100% of districts provide timely reporting on key indicators based on quality data, for decision-making at all levels. By 2016, test 100% of suspected malaria cases presenting in health facilities and communities and treat according to national guidelines
